about: Kenora is a city in northwestern Ontario on Lake of the Woods, near the Manitoba border along the Trans-Canada Highway. A harbour downtown, island-studded lake scenery, and a long role as a railway and tourism gateway define the place. Boat traffic and summer cottagers fill the waterfront. About 15,000 people live in Kenora.
